name: Native original Great Work AI to human to Free Cities Core bridge physical proof

condition.code:
local plan=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER')
if not plan or not plan.WorkIndex or not plan.ID then return false end
local donor=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Work.X,plan.Work.Y)
local bridge=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Recovery.X,plan.Recovery.Y)
local free=CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y)
return donor and donor:GetOwner()==plan.Work.Owner
 and donor:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Work.Building,plan.Work.Slot)==plan.WorkIndex
 and bridge and bridge:GetOwner()==plan.Recovery.Owner
 and bridge:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Recovery.Building,plan.Recovery.Slot)==-1
 and free and free:GetOwner()==plan.Free and free:GetID()==plan.ID
 and free:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Building,plan.Slot)==-1

local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local function locate(index)
 local owners,seen,found={}, {}, {}
 for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if not seen[owner] then owners[#owners+1]=owner;seen[owner]=true end end
 if not seen[plan.Free] then owners[#owners+1]=plan.Free end
 for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do
  local p=Players[owner]
  if p then for _,city in p:GetCities():Members() do
   local b=city:GetBuildings()
   for def in GameInfo.Buildings() do
    if b:HasBuilding(def.Index) then
     for slot=0,b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(def.Index)-1 do
      if b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(def.Index,slot)==index then
       found[#found+1]={Owner=owner,City=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Building=def.Index,Slot=slot}
      end
     end
    end
   end
  end end
 end
 return found
end
ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeBridgeLocate=locate
local found=locate(plan.WorkIndex)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==plan.Work.Owner and found[1].City==plan.Work.CityID and found[1].X==plan.Work.X and found[1].Y==plan.Work.Y and found[1].Building==plan.Work.Building and found[1].Slot==plan.Work.Slot,'original work not uniquely at AI Palace before bridge')
return 'original AI Palace index unique; human and Free Cities Temples empty'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local from,to=plan.Work.Owner,plan.Recovery.Owner
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(plan.WorkIndex)
assert(#found==1 and A.Rules.Equal(found[1],plan.Work),'AI original work changed before bridge')
local working=assert(DealManager.GetWorkingDeal(DealDirection.OUTGOING,from,to))
assert(working:GetItemCount()==0,'AI-to-human working deal has another item')
local choices=DealManager.GetPossibleDealItems(from,to,DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,working)
local candidate
for _,item in ipairs(choices or {}) do if item.ForType==plan.WorkIndex then candidate=item end end
assert(candidate and candidate.IsValid,'AI-to-human original relic is not a valid Core deal item')
local subtype=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorks[plan.Work.GreatWorkType]).Index
local item=assert(working:AddItemOfType(DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,from))
item:SetSubType(subtype);item:SetValueType(plan.WorkIndex)
working:Validate();assert(working:IsValid(),'AI-to-human bridge deal invalid')
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_PROBE',{Index=plan.WorkIndex,Source=plan.Work,Bridge=plan.Recovery,Free={Owner=plan.Free,City=plan.ID,X=plan.X,Y=plan.Y,Building=plan.Building,Slot=plan.Slot},Stage='AI_SENT'})
local result=DealManager.EnactWorkingDeal(from,to)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_AI_SEND] index='..plan.WorkIndex..' result='..tostring(result))
return 'AI-to-human Core bridge submitted; no physical success claimed'

local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local found=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeBridgeLocate)(plan.WorkIndex)
local source=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Work.X,plan.Work.Y))
local bridge=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Recovery.X,plan.Recovery.Y))
local free=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y))
local src=source:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Work.Building,plan.Work.Slot)
local mid=bridge:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Recovery.Building,plan.Recovery.Slot)
local dst=free:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Building,plan.Slot)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_AI_PHYSICAL] count='..#found..' source='..tostring(src)..' bridge='..tostring(mid)..' free='..tostring(dst))
assert(#found==1 and src==-1 and mid==plan.WorkIndex and dst==-1,'AI-to-human bridge did not move the original work exactly once')
local w=found[1]
assert(w.Owner==plan.Recovery.Owner and w.City==plan.Recovery.City and w.X==plan.Recovery.X and w.Y==plan.Recovery.Y and w.Building==plan.Recovery.Building and w.Slot==plan.Recovery.Slot,'AI-to-human bridge missed reserved Temple')
ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeBridgeFirstProof={Index=w.Index or plan.WorkIndex,Source=plan.Work,Bridge=plan.Recovery,Free={Owner=plan.Free,City=plan.ID,X=plan.X,Y=plan.Y,Building=plan.Building,Slot=plan.Slot}}
return 'same original index reached human Temple; AI Palace empty'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local proof=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeBridgeFirstProof)
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(proof.Index)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==proof.Bridge.Owner and found[1].CityID==proof.Bridge.City and found[1].X==proof.Bridge.X and found[1].Y==proof.Bridge.Y and found[1].Building==proof.Bridge.Building and found[1].Slot==proof.Bridge.Slot,'Core bridge source did not match UI physical proof')
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_PROBE',{Index=proof.Index,Source=proof.Source,Bridge=proof.Bridge,Free=proof.Free,Stage='HUMAN_HELD'})
return 'first physical proof persisted for a separate second deal'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_PROBE'))
assert(plan.Stage=='HUMAN_HELD','first bridge proof was not saved')
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(plan.Index)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==plan.Bridge.Owner and found[1].CityID==plan.Bridge.City and found[1].X==plan.Bridge.X and found[1].Y==plan.Bridge.Y and found[1].Building==plan.Bridge.Building and found[1].Slot==plan.Bridge.Slot,'original work left human bridge before second deal')
local from,to=plan.Bridge.Owner,plan.Free.Owner
local working=assert(DealManager.GetWorkingDeal(DealDirection.OUTGOING,from,to))
assert(working:GetItemCount()==0,'human-to-Free Cities working deal has another item')
local choices=DealManager.GetPossibleDealItems(from,to,DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,working)
local candidate
for _,item in ipairs(choices or {}) do if item.ForType==plan.Index then candidate=item end end
assert(candidate and candidate.IsValid,'human-to-Free Cities original relic is not a valid Core deal item')
local subtype=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorks[found[1].GreatWorkType]).Index
local item=assert(working:AddItemOfType(DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,from))
item:SetSubType(subtype);item:SetValueType(plan.Index)
working:Validate();assert(working:IsValid(),'human-to-Free Cities bridge deal invalid')
plan.Stage='FREE_SENT';Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_PROBE',plan)
local result=DealManager.EnactWorkingDeal(from,to)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_FREE_SEND] index='..plan.Index..' result='..tostring(result))
return 'human-to-Free Cities Core bridge submitted; physical proof follows'

local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_PROBE'))
local locate=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeBridgeLocate)
local found=locate(plan.Index)
local source=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Source.X,plan.Source.Y))
local bridge=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Bridge.X,plan.Bridge.Y))
local free=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Free.X,plan.Free.Y))
local src=source:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Source.Building,plan.Source.Slot)
local mid=bridge:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Bridge.Building,plan.Bridge.Slot)
local dst=free:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Free.Building,plan.Free.Slot)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_FREE_PHYSICAL] count='..#found..' source='..tostring(src)..' bridge='..tostring(mid)..' free='..tostring(dst))
assert(#found==1 and src==-1 and mid==-1 and dst==plan.Index,'human-to-Free Cities bridge did not keep the original work')
local w=found[1]
assert(w.Owner==plan.Free.Owner and w.City==plan.Free.City and w.X==plan.Free.X and w.Y==plan.Free.Y and w.Building==plan.Free.Building and w.Slot==plan.Free.Slot,'original work missed exact Free Cities Temple')
return 'original index uniquely stored in Free Cities Temple after two official deals'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_PROBE'))
assert(plan.Stage=='FREE_SENT','two-stage bridge was not submitted')
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(plan.Index)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==plan.Free.Owner and found[1].CityID==plan.Free.City and found[1].X==plan.Free.X and found[1].Y==plan.Free.Y and found[1].Building==plan.Free.Building and found[1].Slot==plan.Free.Slot,'Core did not observe the original work in Free Cities Temple')
for _,key in ipairs({'GreatWorkType','ObjectType','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do assert(plan.Source[key]==found[1][key],'original metadata changed: '..key) end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(plan.Source.Effects,found[1].Effects),'original work effects changed')
plan.Stage='PROVED';Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_PROBE',plan)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_BRIDGE_PROVED] '..A.Canonical(plan))
return 'same original index, metadata and effects verified through AI-human-Free Cities deals'
